Codex code_generation has runtime-routed real execution. Kimi now has a feature-flagged Gateway real dispatch path (14-layer stack: stubs -> dry-run -> audit -> executor -> command executor -> Gateway -> shadow sidecar -> runtime attachment -> real dispatch -> fallback -> observability -> guardrails), ready for controlled llm_task dispatch only (verdict: READY_WITH_CONSTRAINTS). Hermes now has a default-off Gateway real dispatch sidecar stack for review/code_review/validation with fallback policy, sanitized observability, operational guardrails, final readiness verdict READY_WITH_CONSTRAINTS, a plan-only controlled rollout plan, checklist-only rollout validation, a runbook-only operator guide, a template-only post-enablement review template, a contract-only phase-2 expansion contract defining future code_review/validation expansion targets, a checklist-only phase-2 validation checklist, and a runbook-only phase-2 operator runbook; it still does not own Gateway primary result or Runtime final_status/routing.
risks.mitigation: Kimi Gateway real dispatch is feature-flagged and wired (READY_WITH_CONSTRAINTS). Hermes Gateway real dispatch has a runbook-only phase-2 operator runbook for operator-managed validation. Next: phase-2 post-validation review template.
